text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer ran furiously in the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn). Chasing the frontrunner 
Daitaku Helios, she whipped the entire 
crowd into a frenzy.

The final battle for the Best Friends duo 
is the Arima Kinen. Mejiro Palmer decides 
to throw everything she discovered by 
constantly running away from the Mejiro 
name into the race.
